title: Expert Brain Capability
description:
A unit of professional competence, authored as a FOLDER:

  capabilities/<NN-subdomain>/<capability>/
    capability.yaml     <- this file: identity, question, outcomes, failure modes, KPIs, handoffs
    objects.yaml        <- WHICH NOUNS to load. References only.
    knowledge.yaml      <- WHICH EXPERTISE applies: playbooks, heuristics, mental models,
                           rules, decision frameworks. References only.
    situations/*.yaml   <- the situations this capability owns

A capability holds NO knowledge inline. It declares two manifests and owns some situations, and that is the whole of it.

That is a change from the first cut, where playbooks and heuristics were string lists on this file. Three things broke: Layer 6 could not raise a versioned suggestion against a bullet point, MEDDICC existed four times and drifted, and a rule spanning two objects had nowhere to live where it could see both sides of its own condition. The Atlas puts playbooks/, heuristics/, mental_models/, rules/ and decision_frameworks/ beside objects/ for exactly these reasons.

No numbers. Thresholds, weights and scores are Layer 4's arithmetic and belong in the pack manifest. The moment a threshold appears in a capability file, the Layer 3/4 boundary has leaked.

parent_capability.description: Set when this capability is a channel or sub-discipline of another — cold_email under outreach, upsell under expansion. Advisory grouping; it does not affect resolution.

question.description: The one question this capability answers, phrased as an operator would ask it. If it needs two sentences it is two capabilities.

outcomes.description: What done looks like. Feeds Layer 5's success_events.

failure_modes.description: How this capability is characteristically done badly. Often more useful than the outcomes, because it is what an expert actually watches for.

parallel.description: Capabilities that commonly run at the same time and read the same objects.

applies_to.description: Advisory hint only. Authoritative activation lives in the model tree under models/.

why.description: Why an expert believes it. A heuristic without a why cannot be argued with, and therefore cannot be improved.

reads.description: Object ids or property names this draws on.
